trial_title: Identification of Genetic Causes of Calcific Aortic Valve Disease
brief_summary: This study aims to identify the molecular genetic causes of the variability in development of calcific aortic valve disease in bicuspid and tricuspid aortic valves and their associated aortic dilation.

eligibility_table.criterion: Patients with a plan to undergo elective aortic valve replacement and/or ascending aortic surgery
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has severe aortic stenosis and is likely undergoing elective aortic valve replacement.

eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient currently under the age of 20 years?

eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided about the patient's ability or willingness to consent.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient able to provide informed consent as assessed by a standardized consent capacity evaluation?

eligibility_table.criterion: History of aortic valve replacement or transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR)
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has not had a prior aortic valve replacement or TAVR.
There is no documented history of endocarditis in the patient's profile.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient ever been diagnosed with endocarditis or experienced symptoms consistent with endocarditis, such as fever, new heart murmur, or embolic phenomena?

eligibility_table.justification: There is no documented history of rheumatic fever in the patient's profile.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient ever been diagnosed with rheumatic fever?

eligibility_table.justification: There is no documented history of chest radiotherapy in the patient's profile.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient received chest radiotherapy at any point in their medical history?

eligibility_table.justification: There is no documented history of organ transplant in the patient's profile.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient undergone an organ transplant at any point in their medical history?
